prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: "Chinoko, let's go bathing!" "No, we'll sink!" "We hold ourselves at the grass!" "We'll cut our hands!" "We'll put on mittens!" "We'll drench the mittens". "We'll dry [them]". "They'll dry out". "We'll knead [them]". "They'll break". "We'll darn [them] with the needle!" "The needle is blunt". "We'll sharpen [it] with a file". "The file is outworn". "We'll chop [it] off with a chisel". "Where is the chisel?" "In the bag". "Where is the bag?" "In the granary". "Where is the granary?" "The fire ate [it]". "Where is the fire?" "The rainy wind has blown [it] out". "Where is the rainy wind?" "The water spirit drank [it] up". "Where is the water spirit?" "There it is hardly visible".
